HOME_DOOM_LOW: The campfire still burns high. The ink hangs on the horizon like rain that hasn't decided to fall.
HOME_DOOM_MID: The street names have faded a little more. People in the camp have started writing important things on their hands.
HOME_DOOM_HIGH: The Fading is close. The codex pages feel cold — all that will remain is what you write yourself.
NGPLUS_TOAST: You return to before the Tidewake carrying scraps of the codex. A Weaver's Fragment comes with you; your Compendium and unlocks are kept.
LOCK_DEFAULT: The gatekeeper only honors the mark — and your codex doesn't hold that page yet.
LOCK_CHAPTER_TEXT: The codex closes here — the pages beyond haven't been opened for you yet.
SHOP_LINE_CAMPAIGN: %s — %s. One unlock, and your codex carries on from this page.
MSG_RESUMED: The codex falls open at the page where you last left off.
MSG_REWIND_BATTLE: You close the codex. This page's rain is gently turned back to the beginning.
MSG_REWIND_STORY: You close the codex. That's where this part of the story stops.
MSG_REWIND_SUB: You close the codex. The ring's ink gong fades away.
MSG_REST: You take a long rest at the inn. Your wounds are rewritten and your Hit Dice restored.
MSG_LONG_REST_CAMP: You make camp for a long rest. Wounds close and Hit Dice return — but the ink fades a little more (Doom Clock +{clock}).
